item.summary: fix(discord): preserve authored block order in presentation components (#119506) buildDiscordPresentationComponents rendered presentations in two passes - all text/context/divider blocks first, then every buttons/select block - so any block authored after a control was moved above it and controls always sank below all prose. Discord Components V2 layouts interleave freely and the deprecated single-pass renderer pins interleaving as the contract, so merge the passes into one order-preserving loop (title still pinned first).
